deadline.value: The department's international deadline for fall is March 15; domestic is June 15.
deadline.quote: Fall Semester: Mar. 15 for international students and Jun. 15 for domestic students

gre_general.value: The Dec 2024 Graduate College table lists the GRE as required, with a verbal plus quantitative score of at least 300 as a target.
gre_general.quote: Civil & Environmental Engineering Ph.D. Yes GRE

also.quote: GRE verbal and quantitative GRE score of at least 300

gre_subject.value: Civil engineering has no GRE subject test.

supervisor.value: The department page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department reports that a share of its students are funded, but does not guarantee funding for PhD applicants.
funding.quote: of CEEC Students are funded by extramural research and state funds

entry_route.value: Two tracks: a post-bachelor's PhD (ten semesters) or a post-master's PhD (eight semesters).

notes: The Dec 2024 table gives the GRE as required; the department page does not mention the GRE. A GPA figure from an unfetched catalog search result is not used. The 45% funding figure is for all CEEC students, so funding is Not stated.
